URmessage, identity phase 1, slice 1
This is a test build of identity phase 1, slice 1.

WHAT IS NEW
One ID for your account. The first time it starts, URmessage sets up this computer:
  - "This is my first device" shows your recovery phrase, 25 words, once. Write them on paper.
  - Then type them back. A wrong word is named, and nothing is corrected for you.
  - Settings, then Account, shows "Your ID" (36 characters, with Copy) and this device, with its
    device ID and the mark that it holds your phrase's key.
These words cannot bring your account back yet. URmessage never stores them. On the computer
itself, the screens that show or take them are kept out of screenshots and screen sharing. Over
Remote Desktop they cannot be, because that would black the window out for you: the screen says
so, and it is better to set up on the computer itself.

NOT IN THIS BUILD
Adding a second computer to your account, removing a device and changing the phrase come in later
builds. A conversation still starts with today's join code.

HOW TO RUN IT
1. Unzip this folder anywhere.
2. Put the credential file you were sent at %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\dev\user1.jwt
3. Run URmessage.exe.

AN OLDER BUILD'S DATA
This build keeps everything under %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\app. Its conversations, and the names
you give people, are in a new folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\app\live\identity-slice1, and it
never reads the conversations or the names an older build kept. It does keep the settings file,
%LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\app\app_prefs.json (the route through URnetwork, for one), as every build
does. The older build's data stays where it was: the folders "stream" and "state" in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\app\live, and the file local_names.json (the names you gave people) in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\URmessage\app. To delete it, close URmessage, then delete those two folders and that
file. Do not delete identity-slice1 or app_prefs.json.
